# SolveLang

SolveLang is an early beta readable scripting language and workflow-mapping service for AI-assisted business workflows.

SolveLang helps founders, operators, and technical founders turn messy support, intake, lead routing, and internal operations workflows into readable automation blueprints, human review points, and SolveLang-style workflow drafts.

## Key Pages

- Website: https://www.solve-lang.com/
- Workflow X-Ray Audit Intake: https://www.solve-lang.com/audit/
- Support Triage Demo: https://www.solve-lang.com/demo/support-triage/
- Browser Preview: https://www.solve-lang.com/run/
- Pricing: https://www.solve-lang.com/pricing/
- Resources: https://www.solve-lang.com/resources/
- GitHub: https://github.com/saiidz/solvelang

## Current Boundaries

- SolveLang is early beta.
- The browser preview is a safe static preview and does not call a server.
- The Rust CLI runtime exists for local experimentation.
- Full hosted Rust runtime execution, production integrations, managed automation hosting, auth, and payment flows are later work.
- SolveLang should not be described as production-ready or fully hosted yet.

## Main Call To Action

Send one messy workflow for a Workflow X-Ray Audit. SolveLang can map the trigger, decisions, missing branches, human review points, SolveLang-style workflow draft, automation path, and setup recommendation.

Contact: hello@solve-lang.com
